data.title: ULTRALOQ Launches Next-Generation Smart Lock Collection: Refining Home Entry with Natural, Intelligent and Trusted Access Solutions
data.description: ULTRALOQ, a top smart lock brand under Xthings, an IoT leader, recently unveiled their latest products at a launch event in Las Vegas and San Jose on September 25, 2026. The new offerings include the Bolt Mission, Bolt Pro, and Latch 5 Pro, providing homeowners with the option of either precise, hands-free UWB entry or tap-to-unlock digital keys. These innovative products aim to enhance home security and convenience.

data.title: TruTrade Showcases the Next Generation of Automated Trading Technology for Retail Traders
data.description: In Scottsdale, Arizona, a software firm called TruTrade revealed its cutting-edge trading technology on Sept. 25, 2026. The company focuses on automated trading tools aimed at retail traders. With their latest platform, TruTrade aims to provide advanced trading automation features for retail traders.

data.title: AI Apps and Agents Are Taking Off. Gen Can Help People Understand What Happens to Their Data.
data.description: New data reveals that approximately 33% of individuals utilize AI applications and agents, demonstrating a significant trend towards AI adoption. In response to this growing demand, a company based in Mountain View, California, has invested in expanding its Agent Trust Hub. This expansion includes the introduction of the new AI Data Checker feature. The use of AI is evolving beyond simply answering inquiries, with an increasing number of users delegating tasks to AI technology.

data.title: Pennsylvania Trauma Systems Foundation Approval for Elevation of Level II Trauma Center to a Level I Status
data.description: In Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania, on September 25, 2026, it was announced that starting on October 1, 2026, St. Luke's Hospital – Anderson Campus in Easton, PA has been granted approval for a significant upgrade in trauma center accreditation from Level II to Level I. This decision increases the total number of accredited trauma centers to 56.

data.title: Immunovant Investigation Notice: SueWallSt Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into Immunovant (IMVT)
data.description: On September 23, 2026, Immunovant's stock experienced a decline of about 6%, dropping to a low not seen in over three months. This drop came after the IMVT-1402 study for cutaneous lupus failed to meet its primary goal. In light of this, SueWallSt has alerted investors about a possible investigation regarding violations of securities laws that could impact IMVT shareholders.

data.title: Taiwan Tourism Administration Kicks Off Taiwan Tourism Workshops in New York, Chicago and Los Angeles
data.description: Today, the Taiwan Tourism Administration (TTA) kicked off its workshop series in New York to promote tourism opportunities from North America to Taiwan. The workshop attracted over 70 participants as Taiwan offers over 200 weekly direct flights, making it an attractive destination for long-haul travelers, transit passengers, and repeat visitors. This initiative seeks to strengthen ties between the two regions and boost tourism numbers from North America to Taiwan.

data.title: Stayntouch Powers Full PMS Migration Across Imperial London Hotels, Including the Largest Hotel in Western Europe
data.description: A large hotel group in London, Imperial London Hotels, recently finished transferring seven of its properties to Stayntouch, a prominent cloud hotel property management system. The final property to transition was the Royal National Hotel, which boasts 1,379 rooms. This migration was completed in phases and marks a significant achievement for both Imperial London Hotels and Stayntouch. The completion of this process occurred on September 25, 2026. Stayntouch is recognized as a global frontrunner in cloud-based PMS solutions.

data.title: Kentucky American Water Restores Water Service to Customers of Black Mountain Water Utility Following Devastating Flood
data.description: In Lexington, Kentucky on September 25, 2026, Kentucky American Water successfully restored water service to around 200 residences, served by Black Mountain Utility District in Harlan County, after a severe flood impacted the area earlier in the week. The company deployed crews to address the situation and ensured that the affected households had access to clean water once again.

data.title: Circle and Tether freeze $318,000 in USDC and USDT tied to Bitget hack; attacker converts most to ETH before action.
data.description: Two companies issuing stablecoins took action against a wallet named "Bitget Exploiter 8" by blacklisting it, thereby restricting access to approximately $318,000 in USDC and USDT. However, the perpetrator managed to transfer the majority of the funds into Ethereum, which cannot be frozen, before any measures could be taken.

data.title: Bending Spoons successfully syndicates upsized term loan B add-ons
data.description: Milan-based company Bending Spoons has effectively syndicated and priced a $1.25 billion extension to its current US dollar-denominated senior secured term loan B, maturing in 2031, along with a €395 million extension to its existing euro-denominated senior secured term loan B, also maturing in 2031. These amounts surpass the initial targets of $750 million and €250 million. The add-ons, which meet specific conditions, are interchangeable and maintain consistent terms with the original loans.
